description: Dashboard upgrade: new storage functions + new components (BillHistory, SavingsActionCenter, DemoControls) + upgrades to ConsumptionForm, RecommendationPanel, BillCard, WhatIfSimulator + integration into CalculatorPage. Depends on nothing in FEAT-001 (both are independent). This is the largest feature.
steps: 1. Add to src/utils/storage.ts: (a) BILL_HISTORY key to KEYS constant ('wattwise_bill_history'); (b) BillHistoryEntry interface: { month: string; consumption: { peak: number; normal: number; offPeak: number }; bills: Record<string, number>; cheapestPlanId: string }; (c) loadBillHistory(): BillHistoryEntry[]; (d) saveBillHistory(entries): void (max 12); (e) addBillHistoryEntry(entry): BillHistoryEntry[]; (f) loadDemoData(): void — sets consumption to {peak:180,normal:300,offPeak:120}, budget to 3000, adds 3 sample history entries for past 3 months with realistic bill values (basic~3894, tou~3885, economy~3666 based on 180/300/120 kWh). Do NOT rename or remove existing functions.

2. Upgrade src/components/ConsumptionForm.tsx: add 'Load Demo Scenario' button (sets peak=180, normal=300, offPeak=120 via onChange prop) and 'Reset' button (sets all to 0). Show total kWh prominently in a styled div. Keep color-coded period labels (red=peak, yellow=normal, blue=off-peak). Props interface unchanged: { value, onChange, errors }. Add aria-labels to buttons.

3. Upgrade src/components/BillCard.tsx: (a) add a 4px top border matching plan color using style={{borderTop: `4px solid ${b.color}`}}; (b) add annual cost line: formatINR(b.totalBill * 12) + '/year' in text-xs text-gray-400 below the monthly amount; (c) add aria-label to the card div. Keep all existing logic.

4. Upgrade src/components/RecommendationPanel.tsx: add a 'Smart Savings Actions' subsection below the existing content. Rules: (a) if consumption.peak > 100 — show 'Shift 20% of peak usage to off-peak' with calculated saving: call calculateBill on cheapest plan with adjusted consumption (adjustedPeak = peak*0.8, adjustedOffPeak = offPeak + peak*0.2, normal unchanged) to get newBill, saving = cheapestBill - newBill, show if > 0; (b) always show 'Switch to cheapest plan' action using savings from savingsVsCheapest of the most expensive plan. Add onTryScenario prop: (newConsumption: ConsumptionInput) => void (optional, default no-op). The 'Try This Scenario' button calls onTryScenario with the adjusted values. Import ConsumptionInput from billing.ts and calculateBill from billing.ts. Add consumption: ConsumptionInput to Props.

5. Upgrade src/components/WhatIfSimulator.tsx: (a) add Peak Shift slider (0–50%, step 5%) — state: peakShiftPct, recalculates adjustedPeak = consumption.peak*(1-peakShiftPct/100), adjustedOffPeak = consumption.offPeak + consumption.peak*(peakShiftPct/100), passes adjusted values to generateWhatIfSeries; (b) add Consumption Change quick buttons (±10%, ±20%, ±30%) — state: consumptionScale (default 1.0), scales all three values proportionally for the chart; (c) show before/after summary: Original bill on cheapest plan (using real consumption) vs Simulated bill (using adjusted+scaled), monthly saving in green if positive. Use calculateAllBills from billing.ts. Keep existing maxPeak control and line chart.

6. Create src/components/BillHistory.tsx: interface BillHistoryEntry imported from storage.ts. Features: (a) 'Save This Month' button — reads current consumption + breakdowns from props, calls addBillHistoryEntry, updates local state; (b) table showing month (formatted 'Mon YY'), total kWh, cheapest plan name, cheapest bill amount with formatINR; (c) Recharts LineChart showing cheapest bill over time (x=month label, y=bill amount); (d) month-over-month change indicator (green arrow down if cheaper, red arrow up if more expensive, with amount); (e) 'Clear History' button with confirmation; (f) empty state with helpful message; (g) localStorage note 'Your data is stored only in this browser'. Props: { consumption: ConsumptionInput; breakdowns: BillBreakdown[]; cheapestId: string | null }.

7. Create src/components/SavingsActionCenter.tsx: rule-based savings cards. Props: { consumption: ConsumptionInput; breakdowns: BillBreakdown[]; cheapestId: string | null; onTryScenario: (c: ConsumptionInput) => void }. Three rule cards: (a) Peak Shift — if peak > 100: adjustedPeak=peak*0.8, adjustedOffPeak=offPeak+peak*0.2, calculate saving on cheapest plan using calculateBill, show action/why/saving/Try This Scenario button; (b) Plan Switch — find most expensive plan, show monthly+annual savings vs cheapest, 'Switch to [cheapest plan]' text; (c) Consumption Reduction — reduce all values by 10%, calculate new cheapest bill, show saving. Each card: white bg, rounded-2xl, border-l-4 in accent color, icon, title, why, formatINR saving, button. Collapsible section wrapper (open by default) in CalculatorPage.

8. Create src/components/DemoControls.tsx: amber info bar. Props: { onLoadDemo: () => void; onReset: () => void }. Shows 'Demo Mode' label, 'Load Demo Scenario' button (calls onLoadDemo), 'Reset Everything' button (calls onReset with confirm dialog). Style: bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 text-amber-800, full width below CalculatorPage header.

9. Update src/pages/CalculatorPage.tsx: (a) import BillHistory, SavingsActionCenter, DemoControls; (b) add 'history' to Tab type; (c) add TABS entry { id: 'history', label: '📅 History' }; (d) add DemoControls below header — onLoadDemo calls loadDemoData() then reloads consumption from storage; onReset calls resetAllData() then resets consumption to FALLBACK; (e) pass consumption to RecommendationPanel and onTryScenario callback that calls setConsumption; (f) render SavingsActionCenter below bill cards (collapsible, open by default) with onTryScenario; (g) render BillHistory in the 'history' tab with consumption, breakdowns, cheapestId props; (h) update handleDownloadPDF to pass last 3 bill history entries via reportData.billHistory optional param.

10. Update src/utils/pdfReport.ts: (a) add optional billHistory?: BillHistoryEntry[] to ReportData interface (import BillHistoryEntry from storage); (b) if billHistory exists and length > 0, add 'Recent Bill History' section showing last 3 months as rows (month, total kWh, cheapest plan, bill amount using formatINR); (c) add 'Smart Savings Summary' section with the 3 standard tips (peak shift, plan switch, consumption reduction) as text rows; (d) styled header rectangle using colored rect for a proper banner look (already has this — just ensure it's solid and well-proportioned). Keep existing sections unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: storage.ts exports loadBillHistory, saveBillHistory, addBillHistoryEntry, loadDemoData with correct signatures
ConsumptionForm shows Load Demo / Reset buttons and total kWh
BillCard shows colored top border and annual cost
RecommendationPanel accepts consumption prop and shows Smart Savings Actions subsection
WhatIfSimulator has peak shift slider and consumption scale buttons with before/after summary
BillHistory component renders table + line chart + save/clear actions
SavingsActionCenter shows 3 rule-based cards with Try This Scenario buttons
DemoControls renders as amber bar with working Load Demo and Reset buttons
CalculatorPage has 5 tabs including History, integrates all new components
PDF report includes optional bill history section
